title: 🔥周期估值处于历史极寒区
body: 市场处于历史大底区域。MVRV读数1.22，低于历史79%的时间，且逼近上轮同期2022-08的1.03。这种极低分位显示资产被严重低估，市场筹码已在此位置完成深度清洗。历史数据表明，当前区间往往是长周期行情的孕育起点。偏多。周期钟摆何时回弹？
title_en: 🔥Cycle Valuations in a Historic Deep Freeze
body_en: The market is currently sitting in a major historical bottom zone. The MVRV reading sits at 1.22—below 79% of historical levels and closing in on the 1.03 mark from the same period in the last cycle (Aug 2022). This extreme percentile signals severe undervaluation, indicating that a deep market washout has already occurred at these levels. History shows that this range is often the incubation point for long-term trends. Leaning Bullish. When will the cycle pendulum swing back?
